subject: Verdant MAP and AWS Marketplace PO — action plan & procurement path
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@verdantanalytics.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@verdantanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + AWS Marketplace purchase path

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency/cost profile looked great and the eval team is ready to run a short POC. Procurement asked me to get a clear mutual action plan (MAP) so they can line up the PO process. Two specific asks from our side:

- Can you send a one-page MAP with dates and owner names for the evaluation -> purchase path?
- Confirm if billing will be via AWS Marketplace private offer (AWS pays you, we buy in console) or by direct vendor invoice (we prefer a vendor invoice if possible).

Also, procurement requested the AWS PO template and any standard SOW you usually use for pilot work. We can be flexible on timing but want to close before quarter end if possible.

CCing Amanda (legal) and procurement.

Best,
Sarah
Sr. Product Manager
Verdant Analytics

Attachments: none
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@verdantanalytics.com>
Cc: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@verdantanalytics.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + AWS Marketplace purchase path

Sarah — thanks, and great to hear the eval team is lined up. Draft MAP attached (redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx) plus an initial SOW for the pilot. Summary below and next steps:

Summary (short):
- Evaluation window: 6 weeks (POC start target: 2026-08-24, finish: 2026-10-05)
- Success criteria: throughput >= 50 req/s sustained at 256-token context; <150ms median latency; embedding quality on reference prompt set A > 0.86 cosine similarity baseline
- Procurement options: (A) AWS Marketplace private offer — Verdant completes purchase in AWS Console, AWS remits to Redwood (fastest for procurement teams that require cloud billing); (B) Direct invoicing — Redwood issues monthly invoice Net30 (requires vendor onboarding paperwork & tax forms)
- Recommended: Marketplace private offer to speed close; we can also provide vendor invoice if procurement insists.

Action items I/O (owners):
- RDW: create MAP + SOW (done, attached) — owner: Dylan Brooks — due: 08/17
- RDW: confirm pricing and private offer SKU details — owner: Lauren Bishop — due: 08/17
- Verdant: confirm preferred billing path (Marketplace vs direct invoice) and procurement contact — owner: Sarah/Amanda — due: 08/18
- Both: schedule kickoff call for 08/24 if PO is in place — owner: Sarah/Dylan — due: 08/21

Attachments: redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with milestones), SOW-RDW-Verdant-draft.docx

Let me know if you want us to open the AWS private offer with your AWS account team — we can coordinate with our AWS marketplace rep.

Best,
Dylan
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Verdant MAP - pricing & billing options (internal)

Dylan / Monica — following up on the MAP. Quick notes for the thread:

- Pricing: confirmed list price for private offer SKU is $0.018 / 1k tokens for gen endpoints for the pilot profile. We can offer a one-time pilot credit of $5k if they commit to a production launch by Nov 1.
- Private offer flow: we need Verdant's AWS Account ID + billing contact to create the AWS Private Offer. AWS will issue the private offer link and Verdant accepts in console. Redwood will appear as the seller and AWS processes payment.
- Direct invoice flow: legal needs to accept Redwood's master services agreement and we need W-9/EU tax form + vendor onboarding packet; this can add ~7-10 business days.

Recommendation: push for private offer to meet their quarter-end close; offer direct invoice as fallback. I'll prepare the PO template and the AWS private-offer draft.

Lauren
Head of GTM Pricing | Redwood Inference

Attachments: aws_po_template.pdf
From: procurement@verdantanalytics.com
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@verdantanalytics.com>, Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@verdantanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + AWS Marketplace purchase path

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the MAP and options. Procurement notes:

- Preferred: vendor invoice (Net30) due to our internal chargecoding and tax handling.
- Required paperwork for vendor invoice: completed W-9 (or W-8 if applicable), Redwood's standard MSA with clause on data residency, sample invoice format, and a point of contact for AP reconciliation.
- If Redwood can provide a pro forma invoice while vendor onboarding completes, we can issue an internal PO (PO number will be PO-VA-2026-0921) and commit to payment Net30 after vendor onboarding finishes.

Legal (Amanda) asks for a redline of the MSA; she also requested Redwood's SOC 2 summary and evidence location.

Please send the vendor onboarding packet and a pro forma invoice; we will circulate internally and target PO issuance by 2026-08-25.

Procurement
Verdant Analytics

Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + AWS Marketplace purchase path — next steps and timeline

Procurement / Sarah / Amanda — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and owners so we have a single source of truth: 

Agreed path (hybrid):
- Verdant will proceed with vendor onboarding for direct invoicing (primary), Redwood will prepare a pro forma invoice and provide the vendor packet.
- In parallel Redwood will initiate an AWS Private Offer (backup) and share the acceptance link — this keeps the door open to accept via Marketplace if vendor onboarding slips.

Committed milestones:
- 08/20: Redwood sends vendor onboarding packet, W9, pro forma invoice (ACTION: Dylan) — DONE (attached).
- 08/21: Verdant confirms any redlines to the MSA (ACTION: Amanda) — due 08/21.
- 08/25: Verdant issues internal PO (PO-VA-2026-0921) — procurement target.
- 08/24: Kickoff call (if PO in place) to begin pilot provisioning (ACTION: Sarah/Dylan).
- 10/05: Pilot end / evaluation report due (ACTION: RDW & Verdant).

Success metrics and owner reminders are captured in the MAP spreadsheet. Links and artifacts have been uploaded to the deal record: https://hubspot.com/deal/46829

If procurement wants the Marketplace link as a contingency, our AWS rep (cc'd) will send the private-offer URL within 48 hours of receiving Verdant's AWS account ID.

Thanks — I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with the PO number once it's confirmed and follow up on any MSA redlines.

Best regards,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
